Ordering and payment questions

Does MAGNEETOZ deliver pizza in Greater Noida?

Yes. MAGNEETOZ delivers vegetarian pizza in supported Greater Noida areas. Availability and the delivery estimate are confirmed from your location at checkout.

What is the usual delivery time?

The typical estimate is 25–45 minutes, depending on your address, traffic, kitchen load and rider availability.

Are all MAGNEETOZ pizzas vegetarian?

The pizzas described on these pages are vegetarian. Check the live menu for current availability and item details.

Is online payment available?

Yes. Secure online payment through Razorpay and Cash on Delivery are available where shown during checkout.

What if payment succeeds but my order is not created?

Keep the Razorpay payment reference and contact MAGNEETOZ support. The team can verify the payment and help confirm the order or start the applicable refund process.
